review_method: Inspected the complete final PNG at 2200 px width (displayed at 2048 px) and individually reviewed panels a–d in that rendering; checked final PDF text metrics and rendered collisions.

accepted_warnings.reason: PDF and editable SVG are authoritative native vector exports for this line figure; PNG is a 600 dpi preview. TIFF was not requested.

visual_checks.panel_c: All 28 Llama qkv layers visible, including initial spike; shared logarithmic scale.
visual_checks.panel_d: All 28 Llama down layers visible, including final rise; methods distinguished by line style and color.
